programme.title: INFORMATICA L-31 R - Scienze e tecnologie informatiche

english.notes: Italian-taught Laurea in Informatica (L-31); no English test is required for it. Italian-taught applications list an 'Italian language proficiency certificate ... (if required - please check entry requirements for each programme)'.

value.description: Limited enrolment by TOLC test (TOLC-I); no grade threshold on the school record, only a minimum 12-year school record.

gpa.quote: The degree has the TOLC test as an entry test.
gpa.notes: Threshold is a test (TOLC). Seats for non-EU students residing abroad: 5 (admission page).

deadline.quote: Call One (only for non-EU citizens residing outside Italy): January 7 - March 7, 2027
deadline.notes: Italian-taught degree programmes with a limited number of places (Informatica is 'Accesso programmato'): the non-EU-residing-abroad window for a.y. 2027/28. TOLC registration on CISIA is separate; the programme's own call for admission 2027/28 is not yet published.

value.population: non-EU citizens with a household not resident in Italy, Group B (Scientific) degree programmes

tuition.quote: Group B (Scientific + Primary Teacher Education) All-inclusive fee for students with citizenship of countries not belonging to the European Union and not resident in Italy (B1) € 2990
tuition.notes: Fixed, non-recalculable all-inclusive yearly fee for non-EU students (no ISEE); published under the 'Tuition Fees and Exemptions Notice for the 2026-2027 academic year'. Reduced B2 fee € 996,66 for 'particularly poor countries'. That Informatica (School of Sciences) is in Group B is inferred from the group name, not quoted. Plus regional tax and stamp duty (first instalment 208 euros). 2027/28 not published.

value.name: Veneto Region regional scholarships (University of Padua)

scholarship_exists.quote: The University of Padua, through the Veneto Region funding, supports low-income students (both Italian and international) enrolling in Bachelor's, Single-cycle or Master's degrees and PhD courses.
scholarship_exists.notes: Need-based (ISEE / equivalent ISEE for foreign income), competitive ranking; 2026/27 call: non-EU first-years have their own ranking. The Padua International Excellence Scholarship and the 100 full fee waivers are for English-taught programmes only, so not for Informatica.

scholarship_international.quote: The University of Padua, through the Veneto Region funding, supports low-income students (both Italian and international) enrolling in Bachelor's, Single-cycle or Master's degrees and PhD courses.
scholarship_international.notes: Same quote: open to international students. Need-based, so size cannot be fixed in advance (NEED_BASED_POSSIBLE).
